paite: Huan Elisha in atapa ahihdamsak numei kiang ah, “Thou inla, nang leh na inkote na omtheihna munmun uah va kialtai tadih un. TOUPA'N lah kial akesak ngal a, hiai gam ah kum sagih sung kial ake ding," achi hi.
heading: Shunem Numei Ahong Kik
english: Now Elisha had spoken to the woman whose son he had restored to life, saying, “Arise, and go, you and your household, and stay for a while wherever you can; for Yahweh has called for a famine. It will also come on the land for seven years.”

paite: Huchi in numei athou a, Pathian mipa thugen bang in ahih a; a-inkote toh Philistiate gam ah kum sagih ava kialtai uhi.
english: The woman arose, and did according to the man of God’s word. She went with her household, and lived in the land of the Philistines for seven years.

paite: Kum sagih ahong kivei nung in hichi ahong hi a, huai numei Philistiate gam a pan akik nawn a; a-inn leh alou ngen ding in kumpipa azuan hi.
english: At the end of seven years, the woman returned from the land of the Philistines. Then she went out to beg the king for her house and for her land.

paite: Kumpipa'n Pathian mipa sikha Gehazi ahoupih a, "Elisha in thil thupi ahih tengteng hon hilh dih ve," achi hi.
english: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the man of God, saying, “Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.”

paite: Asisa mi khat ahinsak nawn thu kumpipa ana hilh laitak in hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, atapa ahinsak nawn numei in a-inn leh alou kumpipa kiang ah ahong ngen hi. Gehazi in, "Ka toupa, kumpipa aw, hiai numei ahi, hiai ahi atapa, Elisha in ahinsak nawn,” achi hi.
english: As he was telling the king how he had restored to life him who was dead, behold, the woman whose son he had restored to life begged the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi said, “My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.”

paite: Kumpipa'n numei adotleh ahilh hi. Huchi in kumpipa'n heutu khat asehsak a, "Amah a tengteng, alou a thil piang tengteng tan in, hiai gam apawtkhiaksan a pan tuni tan ateng pe nawn vek un,” achi hi.
english: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, “Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.”

paite: Damaskas ah Elisha ahoh a; Siria kumpipa Ben-hadad achi ana hi. "Pathian mipa hiai ah ahong ve," chi in ahilh uh.
heading: Elisha Leh Siria Kumpipa Ben-hadad
english: Elisha came to Damascus; and Benhadad the king of Syria was sick. He was told, “The man of God has come here.”

paite: Kumpipa'n Hazael kiang ah, "Thilpiak tawi inla, Pathian mipa houpih ding in va hoh inla, ka chinatna a pan ka hoihkhe nawn thei diam, TOUPA hon na dotsakleh," achi hi.
english: The king said to Hazael, “Take a present in your hand, and go meet the man of God, and inquire of Yahweh by him, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

paite: Amah houpih ding in Hazael akuan a, thilpiak ding Damaskas a thil hoih chiteng, sangawngsau sawmli puak khop atawi a, ama ah ava dingh a, "Na tapa Ben-hadad, Siria kumpipa in, ka chinatna a pan ka hoihkhe nawn diam chi ding in na kiang ah kei ahon sawl hi,” achi hi.
english: So Hazael went to meet him and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Damascus, forty camels’ burden, and came and stood before him and said, “Your son Benhadad king of Syria has sent me to you, saying, ‘Will I recover from this sickness?’”

paite: Elisha in akiang ah, "Pai nawn inla, akiang ah, na hoihkhe nawn na mah ke, achi ve, va chi in. Himahleh ataktak in bel asi ngeingei ding chih, TOUPA'N ahon theisak hi," achi hi.
english: Elisha said to him, “Go, tell him, ‘You will surely recover;’ however Yahweh has shown me that he will surely die.”

paite: Huchi in amah a dia zumhuai khop in Elisha in a-ensal gegu a; huchi in Pathian mipa akapta hi.
english: He settled his gaze steadfastly on him, until he was ashamed. Then the man of God wept.

paite: Hazael in, "Bangziak a ka toupa kap ahia?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Israel suante tung a na thil hoih lou hih ding ka theih ziak in ahi. Akulhte uh na hal dia, atangvalte uh namsau in na that dia, atanu neu chikchikte na paizan dia, naupai lai anumeite uh na pikkek ding," achi hi.
english: Hazael said, “Why do you weep, my lord?” He answered, “Because I know the evil that you will do to the children of Israel. You will set their strongholds on fire, and you will kill their young men with the sword, and will dash their little ones in pieces, and rip up their pregnant women.”

paite: Hazael in, "Kei na sikha ui leltak in hiai thil thupi hihthei ding ka hi mahmah a hia?" achi hi. Elisha in adawng a, "Siriate tung ah na hong lal ding chih TOUPA'N ahon theisak hi " achi hi.
english: Hazael said, “But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he could do this great thing?” Elisha answered, “Yahweh has shown me that you will be king over Syria.”

paite: Huchi in Elisha kiang a pan apawt a, apu kiang ah apaita hi. Ama'n, “Elisha in bang hon na hilh a?” achi hi. Ama'n, "Na hoihkhe nawn na tham ding, chi in ahon hilh," achi hi.
english: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master, who said to him, “What did Elisha say to you?” He answered, “He told me that you would surely recover.”

paite: Azing in hichi ahong hi a, puansahpi khat ala a, tui ah adiah a, amai akhuhsak a, huchi in asita a; asik in Hazael alalta hi.
english: On the next day, he took a thick cloth, dipped it in water, and spread it on the king’s face, so that he died. Then Hazael reigned in his place.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Joram kum nga alal kum in huai lai in Jehoshaphat bel Judah kumpipa ahi, Judah kumpipa Jehoshaphat tapa Jehoram alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Jehoramod
english: In the fifth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Jehoshaphat being king of Judah then, Jehoram the son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Alal pat lai in kum sawmthum-le-nih a upa ahi a; Jerusalem ah kum giat vai ahawm hi.
english: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign. He reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

paite: Ahab inkote bang in, Israel kumpipate lampi tot atawn a; Ahab tanu zi in anei hi. Huchi in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihloupi ahih hi.
english: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did Ahab’s house, for he married Ahab’s daughter. He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N asikha David ziak in Judah gam ahihse nuam kei a, asuante tan a khawnvak neihsak gige ana chiam tak ziak in.
english: However, Yahweh would not destroy Judah, for David his servant’s sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.

paite: Adam lai in Judahte tung ah Edomte ahel ua, atung ua kumpipa ding akibawltawm uhi.
english: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah, and made a king over themselves.

paite: Huchi in Zair ah kangtalai tengteng toh Joram ahoh hi. Zan in akisakhia a, amau um Edomte leh akangtalai tung ua heutute ava sualta hi. Huchi in mite apuaninte uah atai uhi.
english: Then Joram crossed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him; and he rose up by night and struck the Edomites who surrounded him with the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.

paite: Edomte tuni tan in Judahte tung ah ahel lailai uh. Huai hun mah in Libnah leng ana hel sam uhi.
english: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah to this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.

paite: Jehoram tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah akigelh kei maw?
english: The rest of the acts of Joram, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

paite: Huchi in Jehoram api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi ah avui ua; asik in atapa Ahaziah alalta hi.
english: Joram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in David’s city; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.

paite: Israel kumpipa Ahab tapa Joram lal akum sawm-le-nih kum in Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Ahaziah / (2 Kro 22.1-6)
english: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel, Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah began to reign.

paite: Ahaziah in vai ahawm pat in kum sawmnih-le-nih a upa ahi. Jerusalem ah kum khat vai ahawm hi. Anu min Athaliah ahi a, amah Israel kumpipa Omri tanu ahi.
english: Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.

paite: Ahab inkote lampi tot atawn sam a, Ahab inkote makpapa ahih ziak in, Ahab inkote hih bang in, TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih hi.
english: He walked in the way of Ahab’s house and did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, as did Ahab’s house, for he was the son-in-law of Ahab’s house.

paite: Amah Ahab tapa Joram in Ramoth-gilead a Siria kumpipa Hazael ava douna ah apang sam hi. Siriate'n Joram ana hihliam uhi.
english: He went with Joram the son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth Gilead, and the Syrians wounded Joram.

paite: Siria kumpipa Hazael adouna uah Siriate'n Ramah ah kumpipa Joram ana hihliam ua, Jezreel a kidamsak ding in akik nawnta hi. Ahab tapa Joram adam louh ziak in, amah veh ding in Jezreel ah Judah kumpipa Jehoram tapa Ahaziah ahohsuk hi.
english: King Joram returned to be healed in Jezreel from the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Syria. Ahaziah the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Joram the son of Ahab in Jezreel, because he was sick.
